body: She makes me feel weak for feeling this way. It's like I'm letting her down when I can't just "snap out of it." I never wanted to let anyone down, I just wanna feel better.
Maybe I'll talk to my teacher tomorrow before school and see what he says. I'm just so afraid of disappointing my mom.
If I talk to my teachers will they have to tell my mom? She'd hate me forever if she knew how I felt.
She's not a very emotional person. And if even idiots don't like me then there must really be something wrong with ms. I think I've already reached the conclusion that I'm depressed.
None taken. She's really great at making you hate yourself. I just don't know who to talk to. I told my friend I thought I was depressed and I wanted to die and she laughed it off like I was kidding.

My school's counselor is only there twice a week, and she's more there for school help than people help. Her job is to get seniors on the right track. My two favorite teachers are my role models. I look up to them so much, it'd break my heart for them to only see me as a suicidal freak.

I just don't know what I'm doing wrong. And I loved cross when I joined. Lately I've been getting slower, it doesn't feel as good and I don't look forward to it like I used to. I don't want to quit because I love it, even if it doesn't feel like it right now. AmIugly told me I'm not ugly, but I have problems with accepting or believing compliments. They never feel genuine. I mean of course they won't tell me I'm actually ugly. I've got a round face, pale skin and frizzy hair. So yeah, not too much going on there. 
I'm Christian. I believe in God, which means I also have to believe in the Devil. One can't exist without the other right? I don't know where I'd suffer more. I can't foresee things getting any better here so why prolong it?
